items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: I worked with Timmie Rogers when Erroll Garner's brother was on it.

ctx.x: Erroll Garner and his brother both played piano, and they studied classical piano. I worked with Timmie Rogers when Erroll Garner's brother was on it. I said, 'Man, how come you can read so well, man?' (Inaudible) Martha Gleason told Erroll that everybody thinks it's best for a black man who can't read -- to say he can't read, and it just comes from the heart and the soul. Born in a black man's soul." And when he began to act it out. that's (inaudible). I'm not saying he's no sight reader, but his brother was a…
